What we offer

Full-Service Mobile Grooming

Everything a shop does, done at your curb without the crate, the car ride, or the all-day wait. Your dog is the only one in the van.

Bath & Full Groom

The full service — warm bath, blow dry, brush out, and a haircut finished to the style you want. One dog at a time, start to finish, in the van at your curb.

Learn more →

Flea Shampoo

A dedicated flea bath that clears what is on the coat now and rinses out the eggs and dirt with it. Good first step before a regular groom schedule starts.

Learn more →

Medicated Shampoo

For itchy, flaky, or irritated skin. A medicated wash worked in and left to sit the right amount of time, then rinsed clean and fully dried.

Learn more →

Deshedding Brush Out

Heavy shedders get the undercoat pulled out properly instead of trimmed over. Cuts down the hair around your house for weeks afterward.

Learn more →

Nail Clipping

Nails taken back to a comfortable length and smoothed, done calmly and without a fight. Can be booked on its own between full grooms.

Learn more →

Teeth Brushing

A quick brushing at the end of the groom to knock down plaque and breath. Small add-on that makes a real difference between vet cleanings.

Learn more →

Bows & Bandannas

Every dog goes home finished — a bow, a bandanna, or both, matched to the season. It is the part the owners always take a picture of.

About our company

About Total Makeover Mobile Grooming

Total Makeover Mobile Grooming is a mobile dog grooming service based in Carson, California, working across Los Angeles County. No shop, no kennel, no waiting room — the van comes to your driveway and your dog is groomed start to finish while you stay home.

  • One dog in the van at a time — never crated with others
  • Baths, haircuts, nails, teeth, and deshedding in one visit
  • Flea and medicated shampoo available on request
  • Every dog goes home with a bow or a bandanna

Common questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a groom cost?

It depends on the breed, the size, the condition of the coat, and the cut you want. Call or text with those details and you get a price before anything is booked.

Do I need to provide water or electricity?

No. The van carries its own water, power, tub, and dryer. All that is needed is a legal place to park near the house.

How long does a full groom take?

Most dogs are about an hour to an hour and a half, depending on size and coat. Heavy matting or a full deshed can take longer.

Do I have to be home during the groom?

Someone needs to hand the dog over and take it back at the end, but you do not need to stand outside — you can stay inside while the groom happens in the van.

What if my dog is matted?

Matting is worked out where it safely can be. When a mat is too tight against the skin, the humane option is to shave it out, and that gets discussed with you before anything is cut.

What areas do you serve?

Carson and the surrounding Los Angeles County cities, including Torrance, Long Beach, Gardena, Compton, and Los Angeles.
